items.title: Route `/settings/secrets` renders Secrets
acceptance: GIVEN an authenticated user with a selected project
WHEN the browser navigates to a URL matching /settings/secrets
THEN the secrets screen is displayed at that URL
AND the location, parameters and history behave exactly as in the baseline application

items.title: Endpoint GET /secrets/secrets/default/{projectId} (secretsList)
acceptance: GIVEN the user performs the secrets list operation
WHEN the client issues the request
THEN it targets GET /secrets/secrets/default/{projectId} with the same parameters, body shape and semantics as the baseline
AND the response payload drives the same visible data as in the baseline, with error responses surfaced as an error state instead of a blank screen

waiver.reason: W-011: legacy URL parity for the secrets domain is deliberately abandoned. The baseline path recorded in this item is the real pylon shape (plugin `secrets` + resource modules secrets.py/secret.py/hide.py => /api/v2/secrets/{secrets,secret,hide}/{mode}/...); it is NOT a Go double-mount bug, which is what #137 assumed when it moved the routes. elitea-main serves the domain at the v2 root instead (/secrets, /secret, /hide) with mode `prompt_lib`, which is what the new client calls. Request and response shapes and semantics are unchanged, only the URL differs, so each item is replaced one-for-one by a new item at the delivered path.
waiver.decidedBy: Wave-3 E2E loose-ends pass (decision record 2026-08-09); supersedes the framing in #137
waiver.replacesBehaviour: API-213: GET /secrets/{mode}/{projectID} (mode prompt_lib) with the same parameters, body shape and semantics, served by the v2 secrets handler

AND granting the permission makes them available without any other change
